When Effort Is No Longer Enough

At Some Point, the Answer Is Not to Try Harder

You may have built your life through discipline, responsibility, and hard work. Those strengths still matter. But they may not be what every part of your life is asking of you.

What You May Recognize

Anticipating what others need. Putting yourself last. Quietly carrying more than anyone sees. Understanding the situation and still finding yourself unable to think your way through it.

Private Mentorship

I work privately with a small number of women over six to twelve months. We begin with what is asking for your attention now, and stay with it long enough for something deeper to become clear.

Learn more

What the Work Makes Room For

Less need to manage, anticipate, or control the outcome. More freedom to know what you want, trust what you know, and make choices that are more fully your own.

The aim is not to become a better version of yourself.

It is to see what has been shaping you, often outside your awareness, so you can choose differently.

There is no standardized curriculum or fixed sequence. The work develops in response to what is present, with enough time and continuity to follow what changes, what repeats, and what asks to be understood more deeply.
